title: Kodiak 100K aid-station chart (imperial, 2026 final)
publisher: UTMB World Series / HOKA Kodiak Ultra Marathons by UTMB
claims: The 2026 100K chart places Start at 0.0 miles, Bear Mountain 1 at 4.9, Sugarloaf 1 at 10.4, Balky Horse at 19.1, Sugarloaf 2 at 24.2, Bear Mountain 2 at 30.3, Snow Summit at 36.7, Hydration-Grandview at 40.9, Bluff Lake at 46.2, Camp Osito at 51.6, Aspen Glen at 55.3 and the finish at 62.8 miles.

The chart gives cut-offs of 09:30 Saturday at Sugarloaf 1, 14:00 Saturday at Sugarloaf 2, 16:00 Saturday at Bear Mountain 2, 21:00 Saturday at Bluff Lake, 22:45 Saturday at Camp Osito, 00:00 Sunday at Aspen Glen and 02:15 Sunday at the finish.
The chart's cumulative figures are 10,313 ft of gain and 10,312 ft of loss (about 3,143 m), matching the race page header's 3,143 m+.

The chart marks drop bags at the start, Sugarloaf 1, Sugarloaf 2, Camp Osito and the finish; crew access is at Sugarloaf 1, Sugarloaf 2, Bear Mountain 2 and Snow Summit, with a mandatory organiser shuttle for supporters at Sugarloaf 1, Sugarloaf 2, Aspen Glen and the finish.
The station numbering repeats AS# 7 for Hydration-Grandview and Bluff Lake.
